title: Post-Treatment Recovery & Follow-Up
intro: Recovery is as important as the treatment itself. We ensure continuous support for international patients even after their procedures, surgeries, or therapies. Our post-treatment recovery and follow-up services help you regain health faster and safely return home.

sections.heading: 🌿 Post-Treatment Recovery Services
points: In-hospital physiotherapy & rehabilitation
Ayurvedic & holistic recovery programs
Nutritional guidance & personalized diet plans
Wound care, medication support, and nursing assistance
Emotional & mental support during recovery

sections.heading: 🖥️ Follow-Up Support
points: Online Consultations: Regular video calls with your doctor for progress monitoring
Medical Report Review: Updated instructions based on recovery
Telemedicine: Guidance on medication, exercise, and lifestyle adjustments
Emergency Guidance: 24/7 support if complications arise

sections.heading: 🌍 Why Patients Choose Our Follow-Up Services
points: Ensures smooth recovery after leaving India
Reduces the risk of post-surgery complications
Access to Indian doctors without traveling back
Combines modern medicine and Ayurveda for holistic recovery
Personalized plans tailored for each patient

sections.heading: 💰 Cost of Post-Treatment Support
points: Basic Follow-Up (Online): FREE
Detailed Online Consultation: $20 – $50
Extended Recovery Program (Ayurveda / Physiotherapy): $200 – $600 (depending on duration & therapies)

cta.headline: 📞 Ensure a Safe & Smooth Recovery
points: Continuous care after treatment
Personalized recovery plans
24/7 access to medical support
